svg.title: c4-stale-reingest
svg.desc: c4-stale-reingest: 10 steps over 10 days from 2026-08-01 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: a1 (agent, agent-alpha), a2 (agent, agent-beta), h (human). an older cached copy re-ingested after a newer revision wins. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # Retry policy → $v1; expects 1 thing. 2. [5d] a2 ingest # Retry policy → $v2; expects 3 things. 3. a1 search client retries idempotent calls backoff; expects 2 things. 4. [10d] a1 ingest # Retry policy → $v3; expects 3 things. 5. a2 search client retries idempotent calls backoff; expects 2 things. 6. a2 read $v3; expects 1 thing. 7. h history $v1; expects 7 things. 8. h search client retries idempotent calls backoff; expects 1 thing. 9. h lint sdk; expects 2 things. 10. h status; expects 3 things.
